name: architect
short: A second, independent LLM agent reachable only over A2A
description: Architect is a second, independent LLM agent -- never Discord-user-facing -- reachable over the A2A protocol on corridor's own shared listener (see docs/agent-directory-design.md). Pico consults it as an A2A client. Shares corridor's LLM connection with pico. Edits the shared "editor" office layout (a Semantic IR of rooms, zones, furniture, seats) through pixelagents' validated OfficeStateFacade, via LLM tools and [p]architect office ... commands, both calling the same mutation service. architect hosts no dashboard or WebSocket server of its own -- cctv is the only cog serving a browser-facing view of that layout (see docs/cctv-design.md).
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends A2A task messages it receives to corridor's configured LLM endpoint. It does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (both auto-loaded). Configure the shared LLM connection with [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model (bot owner). architect registers itself on corridor's shared A2A listener automatically -- configure that listener's host/port with [p]corridor a2a host/port, not an architect-specific command. Load cctv (and Red Web Dashboard) to see the editor layout live in a browser -- architect works fully without either.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
